name: dsh-agent-behavioral-governance
description: Agent Behavioral Governance (ABG): an additive project-work governance layer for DeepSeek Harness. Contributes one system-prompt section and uses deterministic runtime seams (agent/pre-step, tools/pre-execute, tools.guard) for enforcement, plus the `abg` terminal interface for control (start/pause/restart/exit), prompt.md editing and the npm lifecycle. Zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.prepack: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const need=['lib/index.js','bin/abg','lib/generated/kernel/export.js','lib/generated/kernel/prompt-compiler.js','lib/generated/kernel/prompt-override.js','lib/generated/kernel/control.js','lib/generated/kernel/prompt-store.js','lib/generated/kernel/lifecycle.js','lib/generated/bin/abg.js','cordis.patch.yml','LICENSE','CHANGELOG.md','README.md'];for(const f of need)fs.accessSync(f);console.log('abg pack: required artifacts present')"
